A '''frequency jammer''' was a device used to disrupt communications and could be used on an entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] employed such a device on the captured [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]] from c. [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] until it was [[Mission to Kynachi|destroyed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]]. It was a type of [[Jammer/Legends|Jammer]].
